verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an interactive API reference, such as an in-browser try-it console or explorer with runnable request examples. What it does show is adjacent: a Test Drive sandbox plan, an OpenAPI spec repo whose test project generates a client library, and MCP-based code generation. These are building blocks or separate features, not the named capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
